newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market $110/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market $110/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 110.00, few early 109.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1225 lbs 110.00, few early 109.00.
Trade on slaughter steers and heifers was fairly active on Thursday morning.
Prices were not established on either class on a live basis. Buyer inquiry good, seller interest mixed.
Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Confirmed - 7,300 For the week - 30,000
